original_catalog_record.Tune and work identity: COMPLETE IN THEE — Talmage J. Bittikofer (1921); Aaron R. Wolfe verses and James M. Gray refrain
original_catalog_record.Public distribution rights: Hymnary WASH1957 #191 explicitly records text and tune copyright 1921 by T. J. Bittikofer, now Public Domain. Actual tune PDF says Public Domain and credits Bittikofer 1921. US-PD basis; territory review still appropriate.
original_catalog_record.Remaining checks / version notes:
Candidate: alternate traditional tune
SAME HYMN / DIFFERENT TUNE: use traditional Bittikofer 1921 setting instead of protected Ben Nyce setting heard in Ben Everson recording. Preserves Wolfe verses and Gray refrain, with historical wording variants. The music PDF has no lyric underlay; pair/engrave using linked full lyrics. Do not use modern protected recording arrangement. Do not mistake Cyber Hymnal HESPERUS setting (without Gray refrain) for this setting.
